viewer: Married homeowners who bought their house in 2000 and are now weighing a sale to downsize.
decision: Sell the house we bought in 2000 now, or keep it, given the $500,000 tax-free limit on home-sale gains?
promise: We measure, metro by metro, how far typical home-price growth since 2000 has pushed sellers' gains against a limit that never moved with inflation.
title: Bought Your Home in 2000? The $500,000 Tax-Free Limit Test
thumbnail: a family house with a sold sign beside a capped glass jar / "Still Tax-Free?"
